metadata.title: 円周上の「自分より高い個数」から、必ず成り立つ大小関係を求める
metadata.summary: 条件に合う高さ順を一つ作り、近い二点の大小が全ての配置で共通することを使う。左右の候補への移動距離をまとめ、多数の比較に答える。

reference.title: 植物の比較 (Comparing Plants)
reference.evidence: 円周の固定長K窓にある自分より高い個数から、全整合高さ順で共通する大小を答える。残余0と直前窓の0依存を解いて一つの順位を復元すると、距離K未満の対の向きは全配置で不変となる。整合配置はこの近距離DAGの線形拡張であり、左右の最高下位候補と距離の二冪表で、その到達性を質問ごと対数時間で判定できる。
reference.verificationNotes: 2026-10-15に主催者公式原典と公式Editorialを再読。公式PDFの通常web/ローカル抽出では数式が欠けるため、AOI公式配布repoで存在確認した英語原典をGitHub読取/base64で取得し、全3頁を画像化して実際に読み、2<=K<=N<=200000、1<=Q<=200000、0<=r[i]<=K−1、0<=x<y<N、全高さ相異/整合配置存在を確認した。公式Editorialの方針と配布満点modelを参照し、残余0選択と未知DAGのsourceの同値、同一除去順から近距離辺の不変性、整合高さ順と線形拡張、rank差帰納による左右2辺圧縮、lift上の折返し除去と目標初横断、最高下位候補の単調道への貪欲挿入を独立に証明した。初回audit未確認fieldsは変更せず、追加の確認として記録。実MDX単一可視完全C++20を抽出し、N<=8/K全値の全362879順列を同一観測215446群へまとめ、全整合順列の比較の共通部分と全13368156質問を照合。N<=6の全71992個数配列で存在判定を比較（不整合68872）。1500乱択/全1924051比較、N200000の6instanceで各200000質問、K1/2/100000/199999/200000、方向/曖昧0/同添字/循環境界/無効状態/copy-moveを検証。通常/ASan+UBSanとも19024422 checks、checksum3615291826092893586。通常1.66715秒/38980KiB、san8.52024秒/708200KiB。競技日2020-09-16は日本委員会公式日別一覧、難度null。

problemFeature.title: 植物の比較 (Comparing Plants)
features: 円周上の各位置について、時計回りの次のK−1位置のうち自分より厳密に高い個数だけが与えられる。窓幅Kは全位置で同じ。
高さは全て相異なり、観測と整合する配置が存在する。その全配置で二位置の大小が確定するか、多数の質問に答える。
原典は2<=K<=N<=200000、質問200000回以下、個数0..K−1。掲載APIはK1と同添字も明示的に拡張して扱う。
problemFeature.notes: 円周の固定長K窓にある自分より高い個数から、全整合高さ順で共通する大小を答える。残余0と直前窓の0依存を解いて一つの順位を復元すると、距離K未満の対の向きは全配置で不変となる。整合配置はこの近距離DAGの線形拡張であり、左右の最高下位候補と距離の二冪表で、その到達性を質問ごと対数時間で判定できる。

api.representative: const std::vector<int>& representative_rank() const; rank0 is tallest
api.input: 1<=K<=N<=200000; each0<=r<K; must admit distinct heights, checked semantically
api.queryRange: 0<=x,y<N, any order; x==y returns0. No query-count state or cap; original Q<=200000 covered.
api.result: 1 iff x taller in all configurations, -1 iff shorter in all,0 iff both strict comparisons possible; identical-index0 is separate extension
api.initializationErrors: std::invalid_argument for empty/oversized N, invalidK, r out of range, or no consistent ordering
api.queryErrors: std::invalid_argument for invalid indices, before identical-index shortcut
api.stateErrors: std::logic_error on compare/representative_rank for moved-from objects
api.copyMove: deep copy constructor; noexcept move constructor resets source n to0; pass-by-value copy-swap assignment gives strong assignment guarantee; self-copy/self-move work
api.allocationErrors: standard exceptions propagate; failed construction yields no usable object, failed parameter copy leaves assignment target unchanged
api.threadUse: Queries and rank access are const after successful construction; each object owns its tables.
integerSafety: Residual sentinel10^9 minus at mostN future decrements remains positive. Lazy values stay within the asserted int range.
4N tree indices and power-of-two segment tree allocation indices are bounded below10^6.
Directional distances are1..N−1 or sentinelN; adding two capped distances is<=2N<=400000.
Circular arithmetic current+distance/current-distance+N stays within[-N,2N]; no negative modulo argument is used.
No height magnitude arithmetic or count sum overN is needed.
api.time: preprocess O(NlogN), each query O(logN), Q queries O((N+Q)logN)

proof.sourceCriterion: Residual0 excludes taller clockwise neighbours. If a taller left neighbour has positive residual, its still taller clockwise witness must lie strictly between it and x, otherwise residual(x)=0 is contradicted. Iteration ends at a left residual0, contradicting the criterion. Conversely a source has residual0 and no left residual0.
proof.zeroSetCriterion: For an ordered cyclic zero set, a zero has no other zero in its precedingK−1 fixed positions iff its gap from the preceding zero is>=K; singleton gap=N. Inserting/removing a zero changes only its own/successor eligibility.
proof.consistencyAndInvariant: The same residual-driven removal run is a topological order of every consistent local comparison DAG. Conflicting orientation of any near pair cannot both be respected, so the near DAG is invariant. A completed run itself reproduces every count; failure to find a source before completion is inconsistent.
proof.linearExtensions: Every topological order preserves all counted local comparisons and hence the observations; all consistent orders are exactly linear extensions. A pair is forced iff one reaches the other. If neither reaches the other, adding either directed edge is acyclic and witnesses both orders.
proof.twoEdges: For full edge x->y in one side window, the tallest shorter side candidate c is y or has x>c>y. Since c,y share a lengthK−1 arc, c->y is a full edge. Induct on strictly decreasing rank difference to replace it with chosen edges.
proof.directionChanges: Lift a full-DAG path onto integer coordinates, choosing a signed displacement of absolute value<K for each edge. Two opposite directions put their outer endpoints in the same lengthK−1 arc, so replace by the direct descending-height edge with net displacement, reducing the number of edges. Repeating yields a monotone directed path.
proof.fullTurns: If a monotone path winds past the first occurrence of target, its first crossing edge starts above target and at distance<K from it. End there directly, so a no-overshoot path exists.
proof.greedy: The highest shorter side candidate c is at least as high as the first next vertex v of a monotone path. If c lies before v, append c->v. If after v, splice c to the first original path vertex at or beyond c, whose crossing edge has length<K and whose height<=v<=c. If c is beyond target, target is a direct near neighbour of current.
proof.query: Follow as many positive-distance candidate edges as fit before target. Existence is preserved by the greedy lemma; the final remaining-distance<K and rank(current)<=rank(target) checks precisely the direct final edge or exact target. Query both directions.
proof.capping: No-overshoot query budget<N, so replacing any jump distance>=N by sentinelN makes it unusable and cannot alter the answer.

flowSuggestion.proposedAnswerLabel: 循環する同じ長さの窓で、自分より高い個数から全配置共通の大小を問う

guards.feature: 円周の固定位置で、全位置共通Kの次K−1位置にいる自分より厳密に高い個数を知る。
高さは全て相異なり、整合配置が存在する。全整合配置で二位置の大小が確定するかを求め、曖昧なら0とする。
1<=K<=N<=200000、個数0..K−1。質問20万回以下なら全体O((N+Q)logN)で扱える。

verification.oracle: For every N1..8,K1..N enumerate ALL N! height permutations; compute counts by literal nextK−1 comparisons; group identical count arrays. Bitwise intersection of pair comparisons across the whole group is exactly the independently expected forced relation; union gives both witness directions for ambiguous pairs. No greedy construction, graph, segment tree or doubling in this oracle.
extraSmallChecks: Every returned representative is a full rank permutation and literally reproduces its entire observation.
An independently built full near-comparison DAG closure also equals the intersection over all grouped actual permutations, checking the poset theorem separately.
For every N<=6,K<=N enumerate ALL K^N in-range count arrays; constructor accepts exactly those present in the permutation groups.
verification.randomOracle: 1500 shuffled heights with2<=N<=60 and1<=K<=N, seed20200916. Explicitly construct all near edges from the independent true heights, compute bitset Warshall closure, compare all ordered pairs.

maximumCases.expected: all pairs forced, long decreasing path and18 jump levels
only adjacent high-low pairs forced, distant pairs ambiguous
all forced, almost whole circle window
all distinct queried pairs ambiguous; explicit general API extension

otherCases: Both original examples; x<y source calls and reversed arbitrary-order API calls; same-index0 and N=K=1.
N200001/empty/invalidK/count values/inconsistent cycles; invalid query indices even when equal.
Deep copy, move and checked moved-from compare/rank access, copy assignment, self-copy, self-move and interleaved independent objects.

editorNotes: Eight technique sections and one always-visible complete C++20 reusable class; no per-problem explanation page.
Article focuses on model/proofs/API/complexity/code. Retrieval history, test counts and timings are sidecar-only.
Initial shared IOI2020 audit remains unchanged; original unconfirmed facts can be resolved by later source/solution verification after independent review.
Only the three requested technique artifacts are deliverables; PDF/PNG evidence is temporary and retained for reviewer inspection.

Official editorial source is authentic, but missing extracted formulas are not falsely claimed to have been visually read. The necessary definitions and lemmas are independently proved and exhaustively checked.
Original grader interface is online init/compare; the class offers preprocessing once and immutable comparisons, so its complexity includes all original queries.

independentReview.notes: 二者が原典3頁の画像、zero抽出と不変DAG、rank差帰納、単調道とgreedy交換、飽和doubling、全掲載APIを独立精読。作者と独立review者とrootの通常・ASan/UBSanで同一結果。独立reviewではN65..1000の全近距離DAG閉包と反転後観測でも照合。
